ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN

 if :valid_physical_rules.physical_code != :global.physical_code or
 :valid_physical_rules.donation_type != :global.donation_type or
 :valid_physical_rules.item_value != :global.item_value or
 :valid_physical_rules.procedure_code != :global.procedure_code
 then
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05C10C05',
 :global.physical_code||','||:global.donation_type||
 ','||:global.item_value||
 ','||:global.procedure_code||
 ',','D',chk);
 end if;

IF :valid_physical_rules.physical_code = :global.physical_code and
 :valid_physical_rules.donation_type = :global.donation_type and
 :valid_physical_rules.item_value = :global.item_value and
 :valid_physical_rules.procedure_code = :global.procedure_code
THEN
 null;
ELSE
 if :valid_physical_rules.physical_code is not null and
 :valid_physical_rules.donation_type is not null and 
 :valid_physical_rules.item_value is not null and
 :valid_physical_rules.procedure_code is not null then
 
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM valid_physical_rules
 WHERE physical_code = :valid_physical_rules.physical_code and
 donation_type = :valid_physical_rules.donation_type and
 item_value = :valid_physical_rules.item_value and
 procedure_code = :valid_physical_rules.procedure_code;

 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else 
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05C10C05',
 :valid_physical_rules.physical_code||','||:valid_physical_rules.donation_type||
 ','||:global.item_value||
 ','||:global.procedure_code||
 ',','U',chk);
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319'); 
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :system.record_status = 'CHANGED' then
 if counter > 1 then
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05C10C05',
 :valid_physical_rules.physical_code||','||:valid_physical_rules.donation_type||
 ','||:global.item_value||
 ','||:global.procedure_code||
 ',','U',chk);
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 END IF; /* record status check end*/
 end if; /* 1st if then */
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_AGE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_age IS
 v_its_num varchar2(1) := 'N';
BEGIN
 begin
 if :valid_physical_rules.from_age is not null then
 SELECT 'Y' into v_its_num
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(:valid_physical_rules.from_age, '^[[:digit:]]+$');
 end if;
-- if :valid_physical_rules.from_age = 0 then
-- show_error('1535');
-- check_package_failure;
-- end if;
 exception
 when others then
 if v_its_num = 'N' then
 show_error('18025');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;


 v_its_num := 'N';
 begin
 if :valid_physical_rules.to_age is not null then
 SELECT 'Y' into v_its_num
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(:valid_physical_rules.to_age, '^[[:digit:]]+$');
 end if;
-- if :valid_physical_rules.to_age = 0 then
-- show_error('1535');
-- check_package_failure;
-- end if; 
 exception
 when others then
 if v_its_num = 'N' then
 show_error('18025');
 check_package_failure;
 end if; 
 end;
 
 if :valid_physical_rules.from_age is not null then
 if :valid_physical_rules.to_age is not null then
 if :valid_physical_rules.from_age > :valid_physical_rules.to_age then
 show_error('17014');
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) IS
 dt_chk boolean;
 v_sysdate date; -- Added by Kishore on 09/14/2015. SCR 21483
begin
 -- Added by Kishore on 09/14/2015. SCR 21483
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 else
 v_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- End of change for SCR 21483
 
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 --if eff_date < trunc(sysdate) and from_where = 'E' then -- Commented by Kishore on 09/14/2015. SCR 21483
 if eff_date < trunc(v_sysdate) and from_where = 'E' then -- Added by Kishore on 09/14/2015. SCR 21483
 show_error('5015');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 --if term_date < trunc(sysdate) then -- Commented by Kishore on 09/14/2015. SCR 21483
 if term_date < trunc(v_sysdate) then -- Added by Kishore on 09/14/2015. SCR 21483
 show_error('3115');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK_NUMERIC
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* SCR - 390 - Diptiia - 4/7/05
This procedure will be used to check the duplicate records for Numeric datatype - 
The program will prevent enteries if the donation_type, procedure_code and physical_code are the same 
and only the item value is different.
The charatcter data type validation will be verified as before including the intem value.
*/

PROCEDURE DUP_RECORD_CHECK_NUMERIC IS
 counter number(10);
 rec_num number(10);
 --variables to store values in
 v_don_type varchar2(10);
 v_proc_code varchar2(10);
 v_phy_code varchar2(10);
 v_data_type varchar2(10);
 v_item_value varchar2(50);
 v_gender varchar2(1); -- Added by Kishore on 09/14/2015. SCR 21483

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_DB_REC_CHK_NUM

/* SCR 390 - Diptiia */

PROCEDURE DUP_DB_REC_CHK_NUM IS

counter NUMBER(10);

BEGIN
 if :valid_physical_rules.physical_code is not null and
 :valid_physical_rules.donation_type is not null and 
 :valid_physical_rules.procedure_code is not null and
 :valid_physical_rules.gender is not null then -- Added by Kishore on 09/14/2015. SCR 21483
 
 select count(*)
 into counter
 from valid_physical_rules
 where physical_code = :valid_physical_rules.physical_code 
 and donation_type = :valid_physical_rules.donation_type 
 and procedure_code = :valid_physical_rules.procedure_code
 and (gender = decode(:valid_physical_rules.gender, 'A', gender, :valid_physical_rules.gender)) or 
 (decode(gender, 'A', :valid_physical_rules.gender, gender) = :valid_physical_rules.gender) -- Added by Kishore on 09/14/2015. SCR 21483 
 and data_type in ('N', 'D'); -- :valid_physical_rules.data_type; SCR 19683; 'D' also added as part of numeral datatype.
 
 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 show_error('0319');
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK_CHAR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* SCR - 390 - Diptiia - 4/7/05
This procedure will be used to check the duplicate records for Character datatype - 
The program will prevent enteries if the donation_type, procedure_code, item_vale and physical_code are the same 
*/
PROCEDURE DUP_RECORD_CHECK_CHAR IS
 counter number(10);
 rec_num number(10);
 --variables to store values in
 v_don_type varchar2(10);
 v_proc_code varchar2(10);
 v_phy_code varchar2(10);
 v_data_type varchar2(10);
 v_item_value varchar2(50);
 v_eff_date date; -- Added by Kishore on 09/14/2015. SCR 21483
 v_term_date date; -- Added by Kishore on 09/14/2015. SCR 21483

 v_no_of_rec number(10);
 curr_rec number(10);
 t_date_overlap varchar2(1); -- Added by Kishore on 09/14/2015. SCR 21483
BEGIN
 go_block('valid_physical_rules');
 last_record;
 v_no_of_rec := :system.cursor_record; --track # of records in the block for loop
 first_record;--return to first rec
 for i in 1 .. v_no_of_rec loop 
 curr_rec := :system.cursor_record; --track which rec we left off at
 
 if :valid_physical_rules.data_type = 'C' then 
 v_don_type := :valid_physical_rules.donation_type;
 v_proc_code := :valid_physical_rules.procedure_code;
 v_phy_code := :valid_physical_rules.physical_code;
 v_data_type := :valid_physical_rules.data_type; 
 v_item_value := :valid_physical_rules.item_value;
 v_eff_date := :valid_physical_rules.eff_date; -- Added by Kishore on 09/14/2015. SCR 21483
 v_term_date := :valid_physical_rules.term_date; -- Added by Kishore on 09/14/2015. SCR 21483
 
 first_record;--to compare thru the whole block for dups
 counter := 0;
 loop 
 if :valid_physical_rules.donation_type = v_don_type and
 :valid_physical_rules.procedure_code = v_proc_code and
 :valid_physical_rules.physical_code = v_phy_code and
 :valid_physical_rules.item_value = v_item_value and
 :valid_physical_rules.data_type = v_data_type then
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 09/14/2015. SCR 21483
 t_date_overlap := null;
 if v_term_date is null then
 if :valid_physical_rules.term_date is null then
 t_date_overlap := 'Y';
 else 
 if v_eff_date >= :valid_physical_rules.eff_date and 
 v_eff_date < :valid_physical_rules.term_date then
 t_date_overlap := 'Y';
 end if;
 end if;
 else
 if v_term_date > :valid_physical_rules.eff_date and 
 v_term_date <= nvl(:valid_physical_rules.term_date, v_term_date + 1) then
 t_date_overlap := 'Y';
 end if;
 
 if v_eff_date <= :valid_physical_rules.eff_date and 
 v_term_date >= nvl(:valid_physical_rules.term_date, to_date('12-31-9999', 'MM-DD-YYYY')) then
 t_date_overlap := 'Y';
 end if;
 end if;
 -- End of change for SCR 21483 
 
 if t_date_overlap = 'Y' then -- Added by Kishore on 09/14/2015. SCR 21483
 counter := counter + 1;
 end if; -- Added by Kishore on 09/14/2015. SCR 21483
 end if;
 
 exit when :system.cursor_record = v_no_of_rec;
 next_record;
 end loop; 
 
 if counter > 1 then 
 BELL;
 go_record(curr_rec);
 show_error('0319'); 
 end if;

 go_record(curr_rec+1); --back to the rec we left off at + 1- sort of next record 
 --exit when :system.cursor_record = v_no_of_rec;
 else
 go_record(curr_rec+1); 
 end if;
 end loop;

 first_record;
end;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_EQUIP_TYPE

select code equip_type, description from valid_master_codes
where code_type = 'EQUIP' 
and Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,sysdate) between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)
order by sort_sequence_1, code

RecordGroup.Name: RG_PHYSICAL_CODE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code,description from valid_master_codes where code_type = 'PHYCD' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) order by sort_sequence_1

RecordGroup.Name: RG_PROCEDURE_CODE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select procedure_code, description from valid_proc_codes where sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) order by sort_sequence

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DONATION_TYPE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select donation_type,description from valid_donation_types where sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) order by sort_sequence

RecordGroup.Name: RB_INTER_CODE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select inter_code,inter_desc from valid_interdictions 
where /* Time zone changes added by Kishore on 09/17/2015. IM 117 */ lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) /* End of change for IM 117 */ between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10)

RecordGroup.Name: RB_VALID_PHY_RULES
